plan: An armoured mutant who flings his enemies over himself and executes those who are too weak.
aSurveiller: His R (Fear Beyond Death). Below 25% health, he pulls you in and executes you: heal up or stay away.
contrer: When low on health, stay far from him: his R can execute you.
Dodge his dash (E): he flings you behind him.
Don't fight around him: his legs spit fire.
faiblesses: His E is easy to see coming.
